rules.feedback_question:
This must be broken down in two groups of questions: 
TOC 
1a. In the TOC, are all level-1 chapter titles displayed in all caps? 
1b. In the TOC, are all level-2 section titles (X.x) displayed in title case? 
1c. In the TOC, are all level-3 section titles (X.xx) displayed in sentence case? 
1d. Is each entry connected to a page number by a consistent leader style?
1e. Is every wrapped level-1 TOC entry single-spaced internally?
1f. Is every wrapped level-2 TOC entry single-spaced internally?
1g. Is every wrapped level-3 TOC entry single-spaced internally?
1h. Are level-2 and level-3 entries indented to show hierarchy?
1i. Is there visible double spacing between consecutive section-title entries?
1l .If only one appendix is listed, does it begin with “APPENDIX” plus title? 
1m. If multiple appendices are listed, are they identified by letters?

LIST OF TABLES 
2a. Is there visible double spacing between consecutive table entries?
2b. Are all table numbers aligned vertically in one left column?
2c. Are all table page numbers aligned vertically in one right column?

LIST OF FIGURES 
3a. Is there visible double spacing between consecutive figure entries?
3b. Are all figure numbers aligned vertically in one left column?
3c. Are all figure page numbers aligned vertically in one right column?
rules.feedback_remediation:
TOC
1a. Change all level-1 chapter titles in the TOC to all caps.
1b. Change all level-2 section titles in the TOC to title case.
1.c Change all level-3 section titles in the TOC to sentence case.
1d. Right-align page numbers and use one consistent leader style (dots or hyphens).
1e. Single-space every wrapped level-1 TOC entry.
1f. Single-space every wrapped level-2 TOC entry.
1g. Single-space every wrapped level-3 TOC entry.
1h. Indent level-2 and level-3 TOC entries to show hierarchy.
1i.Add visible double spacing or a blank line between consecutive TOC entries.
1l. Rename the single appendix entry to begin with “APPENDIX” followed by its title.
1m. Rename the appendix entries in the TOC to use letter designations.

LIST OF TABLES 
2a. Add visible double spacing or a blank line between consecutive entries.
2b. Align all table numbers in the List of Tables into one vertical  left column.
2c. Align all List of Tables page numbers into one vertical right column.


LIST OF FIGURES 
3a. Add visible double spacing or a blank line between consecutive entries.
3b. Align all figure numbers in the List of Figures into one vertical left column.
3c.Align all List of Figures page numbers into one vertical right column.
